name: Codon and amino acid composition
source: All 89 columns of the DeeplyEssential fold table, identical to the first 89 columns of the DeepHE and DeEPsnap fold tables: 64 codon frequencies, 20 amino acid frequencies, GC content, coding sequence length, codon adaptation index, maximum relative synonymous codon usage and protein length

name: Z curve (800 columns selected per fold)
source: The 800 columns of the Pheg fold table, selected per fold from 4,545 Z curve columns by support vector machine recursive feature elimination on the fold's training labels

name: Supervised fastText sequence representation
source: Columns fasttext_001 to fasttext_100 of the eDNN-EG fold table, trained on the fold's training genes

name: Physicochemical properties and composition (4,250 columns selected per fold)
source: The 4,250 columns of the EssTFNet fold table, selected per fold from 86,151 candidates by recursive feature elimination on the fold's training labels

name: ESM-C 600M embedding
source: Dimensions 0 to 1,151 of the 3,666-dimensional Mahi vector after APPNP propagation on the MAGE global network

name: ProteomeLM-L embedding
source: Columns plm_0 to plm_1151 of the ProteomeLM-Ess fold table, the layer 8 proteome representation of ProteomeLM-L

name: Evo 2 7B embedding
source: The 4,096-dimensional Evo 2 embedding of the EssTFNet fold table, a weighted mean over coding sequence windows

name: ESM-2 650M embedding
source: The residue mean of the ESM-2 650M residue embeddings Bingo reads (1,280 dimensions); Bingo itself reads the residue embeddings and contact maps

name: BioGRID node2vec
source: Columns node2vec_001 to node2vec_064 of the DeepHE fold table, identical to the same columns of the DeEPsnap fold table; BioGRID 5.0.259 physical interactions

name: STRING node2vec
source: Columns n2v__0 to n2v__127 of the HELP fold table, computed by the authors from the human STRING network with combined score at least 0.5

name: Multiplex network GNN embedding
source: Dimensions 3,154 to 3,665 of the Mahi vector: multiplex graph pretraining on 35 MAGE tissue networks, propagated by APPNP

name: PPI degree
source: EPGAT's ppi_induced_degree: the degree in the BioGRID physical interaction graph induced on the task's genes, counted on the whole network as EPGAT counts it when scoring

name: XGEP TCGA expression embedding
source: Columns xgep_000 to xgep_149 of the XGEP-XGB fold table, the authors' co-embedding of the TCGA pan-cancer RNA-seq matrix

name: TCGA expression principal components (50 fitted per fold)
source: Columns expression_pc_001 to expression_pc_050 of the EssSubgraph fold table, fitted on the fold's training genes; EPGAT reads the same components

name: GO cellular component localisation confidence
source: Columns cc__0 to cc__3300 of the HELP fold table, the JensenLab COMPARTMENTS confidence of 3,301 GO cellular component terms

name: GO cellular component neighbourhood enrichment (100 terms selected per fold)
source: Columns go_enrichment_001 to go_enrichment_100 of the DeEPsnap fold table: hypergeometric -log10 p of the gene and its BioGRID neighbours on the 100 GO cellular component terms most frequent among the fold's training positives

name: CORUM complex counts
source: Columns corum_membership_count and corum_neighbor_complex_ratio_sum of the DeEPsnap fold table

name: Pfam domain counts
source: Columns pfam_domain_instance_count, pfam_unique_domain_type_count and pfam_sidf of the DeEPsnap fold table

name: 11 compartment confidences and missing indicator
source: The 11 compartment__* columns and localization_missing of EPGAT's static feature table, JensenLab COMPARTMENTS integrated confidence

name: HELP multi-omics annotation (18 columns)
source: Columns bio__0 to bio__17 of the HELP fold table, named in the header order of the authors' Human_BIO.csv

name: Orthologues in 194 species and missing indicator
source: The 194 ortholog__* columns and orthology_missing of EPGAT's static feature table, Ensembl Compara 115

name: DeepSEA chromatin features
source: Dimensions 1,152 to 3,153 of the Mahi vector: 2,002 DeepSEA chromatin features weighted by distance to the transcription start site, propagated by APPNP
